title: CI: zig build test intermittently stalls on ubuntu-latest after ISS-0134 libc-linking (Zig 0.16 build-runner, mitigated not fixed)
registered_by: Found while resolving ISS-0135 (#433) — PR #435's CI run stalled 25+ minutes in zig build test, blocking merge
scope: CI only (.github/workflows/ci.yml). No source code defect; ISS-0134's Environ portability fix itself is correct.
symptom: zig build test in the Build and unit tests CI job intermittently stalls with zero progress. Observed at 25+ minutes (twice: a main push run and PR #435's first CI run) and again at 4m20s on a follow-up PR (#437) even with the -j2 mitigation already applied. Pattern each time: one test binary streams its result back over Zig 0.16's --listen=- build-runner protocol, then total silence -- 85 of 86 binaries never report.
root_cause_analysis: PR #434 (ISS-0134) added .link_libc = true to the modules underlying most of the 86 b.addTest targets in build.zig, so zig build test now spawns ~86 concurrent 'zig test -lc' compile+link subprocesses instead of mostly libc-free ones. Initial theory (CPU oversubscription from Zig's default job count exceeding the runner's real cgroup quota) is only a partial explanation: a local Docker container matching the observed 2-core quota did NOT reproduce a hang in 5/5 attempts at -j2, including with the same cache-restore-from-prior-run pattern CI uses. The stall's signature -- clean progress up to one binary's result, then indefinite silence -- looks more consistent with non-deterministic scheduler/IPC behavior inside the Zig 0.16.0 build runner itself (possibly upstream) than pure resource starvation. Not fully root-caused.
resolution: Two mitigations in .github/workflows/ci.yml's build job: (1) capped zig build, zig build test, and zig build test-transition to -j2, which measurably reduces the failure rate (PR #435's run completed in 27s with it) though did not eliminate a recurrence on PR #437; (2) added timeout-minutes: 10 at the job level as a backstop so a hang fails fast and visibly instead of silently consuming the 6-hour default. This is a mitigation, not a verified root-cause fix.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test -j2 completes reliably without multi-minute stalls
Real GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest run confirms the fix
acceptance_criteria_status: Not fully met -- recurred once after the -j2 fix (PR #437, run 31001530330, cancelled after 4m20s silent). timeout-minutes: 10 added as a backstop pending a reliable repro or upstream Zig investigation. Issue reopened on GitHub (#436) rather than left closed.
